items.stem: Distinguish between the public sector and the private sector.
items.answer: The private sector is owned by individuals and organizations and usually aims for profit; the public sector is owned by the government and aims to provide services for society.

items.stem: Evaluate the claim: "Social enterprises are more effective than charities at solving social problems."

items.stem: Explain the difference between a publicly held company and a cooperative.
items.answer: A cooperative is owned by its members with one member, one vote; a publicly held company is owned by shareholders with votes in proportion to shares held.
items.markingKey: A cooperative is owned by its members with one member, one vote; a publicly held company is owned by shareholders with votes in proportion to shares held. One mark for a correct account of each side; further marks for making the difference explicit (not two separate definitions).

items.stem: Distinguish between unlimited liability and limited liability.
items.answer: With unlimited liability owners are personally responsible for all business debts; with limited liability their losses are limited to the amount invested.
items.markingKey: With unlimited liability owners are personally responsible for all business debts; with limited liability their losses are limited to the amount invested. One mark for a correct account of each side; further marks for making the difference explicit (not two separate definitions).

items.answer: The private sector is owned by individuals and organizations and usually aims for profit; the public sector is owned by the government and aims to provide services for society.
